infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Market Mapper requires location access to map business coordinates and record market footpaths accurately in the field.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Background location access is required to accurately record uninterrupted footpaths through market corridors when the screen is dimmed.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Market Mapper requires camera access to capture storefront photos, landmarks, and catalogue suggestions in the field.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Market Mapper to record path coordinates while surveying market corridors.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Market Mapper to capture business storefront and landmark photos.
